idea-plugin.name: Claude Brains
idea-plugin.description:
Develop in the IDE. Configure in the Terminal. Claude Code for JetBrains IDEs (unofficial). Runs Anthropic's official claude CLI inside PhpStorm and other IntelliJ IDEs, wired to the editor through the same IDE-MCP bridge the VS Code extension uses. Opens in a right-side tool window. Requires the claude CLI installed and logged in — does not bundle or redistribute Anthropic code. Not affiliated with Anthropic or JetBrains.

Philosophy

The plugin complements the terminal — it does not replace it. What you reach for constantly while writing code lives in the panel, one keystroke from the file you are looking at: asking, editing, reviewing diffs, approving commands, switching model, mode or effort, resuming past conversations. Everything occasional stays in the CLI, where it already works and is already documented — logging in, MCP servers, hooks, permission rules, agents, and the rest of ~/.claude. Nothing is rebuilt in the IDE just to have it there.

By design

  • Login happens in the terminal — sign in once by running claude; the plugin picks up that session. There is no in-IDE login flow.
  • Configuration lives in the CLI — settings, MCP servers, hooks and permission rules are managed the way the CLI already documents. The plugin has no settings page of its own; the claude binary is resolved from PATH (or the -Dclaude.executable JVM option).
  • Only verified slash commands are enabled — sixteen built-ins (/compact, /btw, /context, /code-review, /init and more), plus your project and user commands, skills and MCP prompts, auto-enabled with a source badge. A headless stream has no interactive terminal, so commands that need one are hidden rather than half-working. Model, mode, effort and new conversation have dedicated panel controls instead.

Not there yet

  • Dark UI only — the panel does not follow light IDE themes.
  • One conversation at a time — full history with resume and replay exists, tabs don't.
  • No auto-context from the editor — the current selection isn't attached automatically; use @-file mentions or paste.

action.description: Open Chrome DevTools for the Claude Brains chat panel
